title: Universal cochain presentation of simultaneous strict integral reduction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$, with independent scheme and coefficient universes. Use the completed coefficient sheaf $B_W$ and its actual positive quotient reductions [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], the category $\mathsf S_A(W)$ of strict quotient systems and its exact evaluation and scalar restriction $U$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and flat-term K-flat complexes [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex]. Use the canonical ordinary finite quotient maps and finite derived reduction computations [def-sf-finite-reduction-computation]. Define an IntegralStrictReductionModel to consist of: an additive ordinary functor $T:\operatorname{Mod}(B_W)\to\mathsf S_A(W)$; natural identifications of each evaluation with actual ordinary finite scalar extension, intertwining every quotient transition; an augmentation $\Delta\to TU$ whose section formula is $x\mapsto1\otimes x$ under those identifications; an adjunction $T\dashv\lim U$ whose unit projects to precisely this augmentation; a functor $\mathcal R:D(B_W)\to D(\mathsf S_A(W))$ with a universal left-derived cochain counit $Q\mathcal R\to T_{\mathrm{complex}}Q$, invertible on each flat-term K-flat complex; and finite evaluation isomorphisms to the actual derived finite scalar extensions, commuting with that counit, the ordinary level identifications and the canonical finite computation. This defines data and their equations only: no model is chosen and no existence theorem is asserted. The universal counit records the simultaneous construction before evaluation.
